opening.argument: The presentation ties earnings to recruiting a multi-level team and participating in package tiers. It describes inviting two players who each add two more people to the network, while explaining that commissions are calculated from the weaker leg: "in this case we get 10% from weak leg". Package participation is paired with projected earnings of "two or three thousand euros". The growth slide presents OneCoin reaching €50 in a base scenario and €100 in an optimistic scenario over three years, from €0.5. Although the speaker calls these figures "these are again forecasts,", the presentation still uses them to encourage participation by portraying network commissions, package-linked bonuses, and substantial token growth as possible earnings. The combined recruitment structure and tiered projections establish the stated scheme.
